excerpt.zh:
虚空虫的最后一个家园星系已经被摧毁，它们物种也已灭绝。

我们不再需要担心它们的寄生攻击。
excerpt.en:
The last of the Voidworm home systems has been destroyed, and their species has been eradicated.

We need no longer concern ourselves with their parasitic bombardments.

texts.zh:
虚空虫的最后一个家园星系已经被摧毁，它们物种也已灭绝。

我们不再需要担心它们的寄生攻击。
texts.en:
The last of the Voidworm home systems has been destroyed, and their species has been eradicated.

We need no longer concern ourselves with their parasitic bombardments.

texts.zh:
我们已经铲除了一个虚空虫的母星系。

它们将无法再利用这些产卵地来抚育幼虫。
texts.en:
We have eradicated a Voidworm home system.

They will no longer be able to make use of these spawning grounds to raise their young.

texts.zh:
星系中虚空虫的数量已达到临界值，它们的习性正在发生显著变化。

它们生命周期中原本会放任宿主物种繁衍一段时间的阶段已打破，它们似乎不再顾及这些产卵地是否能够维持可持续性。

我们所有殖民地都已进入红色警戒状态。在任何星系中发现虚空虫，都应极其谨慎地应对。

一场泛星系级的繁殖狂潮正在向我们袭来。
texts.en:
The population of Voidworms in the galaxy has reached a critical mass. Their behavior is noticeably changing.

The typical stage of their lifecycle where host populations would be spared has been disrupted. There seems to be no further regard for the sustainability of their spawning grounds.

All of our colonies are on red alert. The presence of Voidworms in any system should be met with extreme caution.

A breeding frenzy on the galactic scale is upon us.

texts.zh:
星系中虚空虫的数量已达到临界值，它们的习性正在发生显著变化。

它们生命周期中原本会放任宿主物种繁衍一段时间的阶段已打破，它们似乎不再顾及这些产卵地是否能够维持可持续性。

我们所有殖民地都已进入红色警戒状态。在任何星系中发现虚空虫，都应极其谨慎地应对。

一场泛星系级的繁殖狂潮正在向我们袭来。

我们之前针对这些寄生虫建立的免疫力，现在已经不再像以前那样有效了。我们需要重新开始研究。
texts.en:
The population of Voidworms in the galaxy has reached a critical mass. Their behavior is noticeably changing.

The typical stage of their lifecycle where host populations would be spared has been disrupted. There seems to be no further regard for the sustainability of their spawning grounds.

All of our colonies are on red alert. The presence of Voidworms in any system should be met with extreme caution.

A breeding frenzy on the galactic scale is upon us.

The immunity we have previously developed against these parasites is no longer working to the same degree. We will need to go back to the drawing board.

texts.zh: 整个星系都在疯传一个令人不安的消息：一种此前不为人知的太空兽群“虚空虫”正在疯狂繁殖。据说，对于那些防御系统不够完善的恒星系来说，这些生物构成了巨大的威胁。我们所有的殖民地现在都已经进入了最高警戒状态。
texts.en: Disturbing reports are being intercepted across the galaxy that a previously unknown species of space fauna known as "Voidworms" have entered a reproductive frenzy. These creatures are reportedly a significant threat to planets without adequate system defenses. All of our colonies are now on red alert.
